source_revalidation: archive and selected member digests are re-read and compared before mapping
explicit_inputs: node role, absolute pressure Pa, temperature K and optional junction withdrawal kg/s
pipe local loss, heat W, segment count and evidence
pressure reference, nomination interpretation, mapping review
unsupported_gates: context and mapping scenario ID mismatch
known_dataset_limit: documented GasLib-11 includes one valve and two compressors and is rejected as a whole by this pipe-only mapping
run_receipt_replay: revalidates mapping/context identity, thermodynamic choices, complete required evidence IDs, exact node roles/states, pipe controls against sealed owner specification, owner specification/context, and source archive/member SHA-256 plus CC BY 3.0 evidence; caller-reviewed flag must remain true
input_snapshot_policy: source record, mapping and context are JSON/model snapshots taken before archive revalidation and owner solve; the same snapshots feed the solver and receipt
